units.source_text: 听罢停战诏书，要是在东京，也许就会有人跑到皇宫前了吧。

en.t: After hearing the imperial rescript announcing the end of the war, if it had been Tokyo, perhaps people would have rushed to the front of the Imperial Palace.

units.source_text: 在京都，也有许多人跑到没有谁在的皇宫前哭泣。

en.t: In Kyoto, too, many people ran to the deserted front of the Imperial Palace and wept.

units.source_text: 这种时刻，许多神社佛阁都供人去哭泣。

en.t: At such moments, many shrines and Buddhist temples offered people a place to go and cry.

units.source_text: 这一天，各处的寺庙都定会兴隆的，但金阁寺却偏偏没有人来。

en.t: On that day, temples everywhere must surely have been crowded, but for some reason no one came to Kinkakuji.
